latest_release.body:
Hyperapp 2.0 brings a host of new features and improvements, empowering you to build more efficient and feature-rich web apps:

- We're excited to introduce our new [Tutorial](docs/tutorial.md), enhanced [Examples](https://codepen.io/collection/nLLvrz?grid_type=grid), and comprehensive [Reference](docs/reference.md).
- **New Features:** Hyperapp 2.0 introduces several new features, including Effects, Subscriptions, and an enhanced Dispatch mechanism.
- Explore the [flowchart](https://github.com/jorgebucaran/hyperapp/blob/main/docs/architecture/flowchart.md) to gain a clearer insight into Hyperapp's workflow. 🔍

### Features

- **[h()](https://github.com/jorgebucaran/hyperapp/blob/main/docs/api/h.md) and [text()](https://github.com/jorgebucaran/hyperapp/blob/main/docs/api/text.md):** The `h()` function creates virtual DOM nodes (VNodes) for defining views, while `text()` generates text content nodes for insertion.
- **[Memoization](https://github.com/jorgebucaran/hyperapp/blob/main/docs/api/memo.md):** Hyperapp 2.0 offers a memoization feature through the `memo()` function to optimize rendering performance.
- **[App Initialization](https://github.com/jorgebucaran/hyperapp/blob/main/docs/api/memo.md):** You can initialize your app by setting the initial state, running a list of effects, or directly invoking an action.
- **Mounting:** Hyperapp 2.0 allows you to specify the DOM element where the virtual DOM will be mounted.
- **[Effects](https://github.com/jorgebucaran/hyperapp/blob/main/docs/architecture/effects.md):** Effects in Hyperapp 2.0 provide a structured way to manage impure code, such as making API calls, handling animations, and more. Effects enhance the predictability and maintainability of your applications.
- **[Subscriptions](https://github.com/jorgebucaran/hyperapp/blob/main/docs/architecture/subscriptions.md):** Subscriptions simplify handling external events and resource management, ensuring safe, pure, and immutable interactions with the outside world.
  - **[Custom Subscriptions](https://github.com/jorgebucaran/hyperapp/blob/main/docs/architecture/subscriptions.md#custom-subscriptions):** Create custom subscriptions when official packages do not meet your app's requirements.
- **[Dispatch](https://github.com/jorgebucaran/hyperapp/blob/main/docs/architecture/dispatch.md#dispatch):** The dispatch function controls the core dispatching process, including executing actions, applying state transitions, and running effects.
  - **[Custom Dispatch](https://github.com/jorgebucaran/hyperapp/blob/main/docs/architecture/dispatch.md#dispatch-initializer):** You can create custom dispatch initializers to customize and augment the dispatching process for debugging and telemetry.
- **[Custom JSX Function](https://github.com/jorgebucaran/hyperapp/blob/main/docs/api/h.md#jsx-support):** Although Hyperapp 2.0 does not natively support JSX, you can use a custom JSX function to enable JSX syntax.

### Acknowledgements

An immense thank you to @zaceno, @okwolf, @icylace, @sergey-shpak, @SkaterDad, and @lukejacksonn. Your contributions have been invaluable. :heart:
